title: About Me creative-direction research catalogue
scope: 40 award-recognized personal portfolios and small creative studios with About/Profile/Studio pages
reading_rate_note: Read-time estimates are source-lane approximations and should be treated directionally.

sites.name: David Heckhoff Portfolio
sites.tone_and_confidence: Direct and technically assured; confidence comes from specificity rather than self-praise.
sites.typography_and_layout: Compact sans-serif type, strong whitespace, small project tiles, and a restrained off-white canvas.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Conventional vertical progression with light transitions; the current live version is quieter than the awarded experimental submission.
sites.pointer_touch: Project tiles and navigation supply modest hover feedback; interaction is secondary to scanning.
sites.media_or_simulation: Project imagery rather than a continuous About simulation in the current capture.
sites.why_it_works: A visitor can understand what David builds and inspect proof in well under a minute.
borrow_for_alexander: Name the specialty in one precise sentence
Use a compact capability cluster before project proof
Let project thumbnails validate the claim
avoid: The biography is too thin for a memorable personal story
A skills list without beliefs can feel interchangeable
sites.accessibility_performance: Light current page is easy to scan; ensure small type and hover-only cues remain keyboard and touch accessible.
sites.capture_notes: Current 2026 live design differs from the 2022 awarded version.

sites.name: Giats — Portfolio
sites.tone_and_confidence: Friendly and enthusiastic, with a confident service-provider posture; the hospitality metaphor softens technical authority.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized display headings alternate with compact explanatory text and long enumerated capability lists.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Smooth scrolling stages headline, portrait/3D media, service chapters, process lists, and footer as separate acts.
sites.pointer_touch: Pointer movement animates the scene and menu; scrolling remains the main route through the content.
sites.media_or_simulation: A prominent 3D portrait/object treatment creates a memorable opening without replacing the written profile.
sites.why_it_works: The page has a clear authored rhythm and a relatable metaphor, but its service inventory substantially exceeds a one-minute read.
borrow_for_alexander: Open with a human metaphor for the role
Use one spatial object as a recurring narrator
Alternate large statements with brief proof
avoid: Long SEO and workflow inventories
Repeating broad quality claims
A service catalogue that overwhelms the personal story
sites.accessibility_performance: 3D and smooth-scroll effects need reduced-motion, keyboard, and low-power fallbacks; direct headless loading was fragile during capture.
sites.capture_notes: Smooth-scroll transforms prevented a reliable native full-page capture.

sites.name: Pedro Matos Chaves · Design
sites.tone_and_confidence: Calm, factual, and professional; authority is delegated to roles, institutions, clients, and recognition.
sites.typography_and_layout: Editorial résumé structure with generous whitespace, compact columns, and sharp typographic hierarchy.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A straightforward vertical index; pacing comes from whitespace and section changes rather than spectacle.
sites.pointer_touch: Simple links and theme control; interaction does not compete with reading.
sites.media_or_simulation: Minimal portrait/project media keeps focus on the career record.
sites.why_it_works: Highly scannable evidence makes a broad career legible, even when readers skip the prose.
borrow_for_alexander: Use a compressed career ladder
Group clients as proof rather than name-dropping inside prose
Separate capability, recognition, and side activity
avoid: An exhaustive CV on the main narrative path
Very small list typography
Giving every accolade equal weight
sites.accessibility_performance: Mostly text-led and robust; compact type needs contrast and minimum-size checks on mobile.
sites.capture_notes: Current live content and dates may post-date the 2023 award.

sites.name: Thibaud Fellay — Portfolio 24
sites.tone_and_confidence: Poetic but grounded; it speaks about aims and working method instead of declaring greatness.
sites.typography_and_layout: Black editorial field, compact uppercase labels, large photographic moments, and tightly controlled measure.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Short cinematic sequence; copy appears in distinct scenes and pixelated portrait/media transitions punctuate the scroll.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover changes image treatment and gives the portrait a tactile digital texture; touch can retain the scroll reveal without requiring hover.
sites.media_or_simulation: Pixel-resolved portrait and film imagery embody the cinematography story.
sites.why_it_works: It reaches a one-minute target while covering identity, belief, method, collaborators, and invitation.
borrow_for_alexander: Give one belief its own full-scale scene
Credit collaborators visibly
Use media as punctuation between short paragraphs
avoid: Low-contrast tiny labels
A poetic vision without concrete proof
Hover as the only way to reveal essential content
sites.accessibility_performance: Heavy imagery and pixel effects need responsive sources and reduced-motion handling; semantic copy remains readable without the effect.
sites.capture_notes: Static PNG cannot fully show pixel transitions.

sites.name: Jhosue Mesias — Portfolio
sites.tone_and_confidence: Concise, optimistic, and client-facing; confidence is expressed as a promise of useful collaboration.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large digital-designer title, narrow explanatory copy, strong black-and-white contrast, and floating project media.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Vertical scroll reveals project imagery between short text blocks; the motion keeps a very small amount of copy lively.
sites.pointer_touch: Drag and pointer prompts add play, but the core page remains scroll-readable.
sites.media_or_simulation: Floating screens and abstract interface fragments act as a portfolio cloud around the text.
sites.why_it_works: The proposition is understood almost instantly and the work follows before attention drops.
borrow_for_alexander: Use a sub-100-word thesis near the opening
Let side projects float through the narrative
Make contact the natural final beat
avoid: Generic phrases about unique experiences
Relying on motion to supply all personality
Too little career trajectory
sites.accessibility_performance: Draggable visual layers should not obstruct text or trap touch gestures; provide stable ordering for reduced motion.
sites.capture_notes: About content is embedded in a single-page portfolio rather than a dedicated route.

sites.name: Veronica Zubakova — Portfolio
sites.tone_and_confidence: Conversational, self-aware, and warm; rhetorical questions prevent the profile sounding inflated.
sites.typography_and_layout: Huge expressive greeting, mixed serif/sans display moments, black backdrop, scattered captions, and portrait inserts.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Typography changes scale and alignment between chapters; images enter as milestones rather than a gallery.
sites.pointer_touch: Pointer effects are playful accents; the page remains understandable through scroll alone.
sites.media_or_simulation: Lecture, conference, and portrait images make non-portfolio activity feel like evidence of character.
sites.why_it_works: It combines professional range, community contribution, trajectory, and levity in a coherent personal voice.
borrow_for_alexander: Use one self-aware question to humanize the introduction
Treat posters and side projects as story milestones
End aspiration with a light human note
avoid: Age-sensitive experience counts
A chronology that becomes a résumé paragraph
Scattered captions without clear reading order
sites.accessibility_performance: Expressive layout needs a linear DOM order, adequate text sizes, and reduced-motion support.
sites.capture_notes: Static image does not communicate the full cadence of typographic entrances.

sites.name: Sai Narayanan
sites.tone_and_confidence: Ambitious and consultancy-led; measurable outcomes make the high-confidence posture more credible.
sites.typography_and_layout: Dark modular page with oversized proposition, verb-led chapters, editorial grids, and compact proof blocks.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Each process verb becomes a scroll chapter, followed by a long experience record and client proof.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover and motion support the chapter changes; reading remains the dominant action.
sites.media_or_simulation: Project and identity fragments illustrate the process without a single persistent simulation.
sites.why_it_works: The Believe–Action–Results frame is memorable and connects philosophy to evidence, but the page is much longer than one minute.
borrow_for_alexander: Use three active verbs as narrative anchors
Attach outcomes to specific roles
Name clients in one controlled proof moment
avoid: Duplicated process language
Long role descriptions on the primary path
A services-first voice that hides personality
sites.accessibility_performance: Dense text needs stronger chunking on small screens; motion should never delay access to outcome evidence.
sites.capture_notes: Visible word count includes extensive role detail and navigation.

sites.name: Grégory Lallé — 24
sites.tone_and_confidence: Cool and factual; it avoids adjectives about the author and lets client context and awards carry authority.
sites.typography_and_layout: Extreme editorial scale contrast: huge About title, tiny labels, generous white space, and ledger-like lists.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A smooth, minimal scroll converts a short biography into a spatial editorial sequence.
sites.pointer_touch: Subtle cursor and hover states reward exploration without introducing a second navigation model.
sites.media_or_simulation: Very little media; typography and whitespace are the expressive system.
sites.why_it_works: Ten clients become meaningful because each receives a short description rather than appearing as a logo wall.
borrow_for_alexander: Explain why selected clients or projects matter
Use one proof ledger instead of scattered logos
Let typography create scale without adding decoration
avoid: Tiny body copy
An awards matrix that feels self-congratulatory
Low emotional warmth
sites.accessibility_performance: Text scale extremes need careful minimum sizes and zoom testing; smooth-scroll must retain keyboard behavior.
sites.capture_notes: Stitched because the smooth-scroll page reports a viewport-height document.

sites.name: Jack Elder Design
sites.tone_and_confidence: Bold but practical; repeated emphasis on audience connection balances the visual bravado.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large black-and-white type, section counters, long vertical composition, and 3D/pixel objects used as anchors.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A long choreographed journey moves through work, profile, experience, skills, and contact with recurring scroll prompts.
sites.pointer_touch: Pointer movement animates pixel/3D details; the page still advances through scrolling.
sites.media_or_simulation: Pixel-scroll objects and project panels give the biography a tactile, constructed quality.
sites.why_it_works: Career evidence and personality are integrated into the same visual system rather than separated into résumé and playground modes.
borrow_for_alexander: Give side projects a legitimate narrative beat
Reuse one object language across chapters
Pair expressive scenes with simple tables
avoid: A 13,000-pixel journey for one-minute content
Repeated scroll instructions
Motion that competes with reading
sites.accessibility_performance: Long 3D scroll needs reduced motion, progressive loading, stable focus, and touch-friendly fallbacks.
sites.capture_notes: Static capture cannot reproduce the 3D/pixel choreography.

sites.name: Nalaprasad — Portfolio
sites.tone_and_confidence: Plainspoken and warm; specific employers and responsibilities provide credibility without inflated claims.
sites.typography_and_layout: Dark page, clear section headings, portrait card, table rows, and restrained cyan accents.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Mostly conventional vertical reading with light Framer transitions and a clean data rhythm.
sites.pointer_touch: Minimal interaction keeps focus on the profile; links and rows remain obvious targets.
sites.media_or_simulation: A single portrait and small ambient accents support the text rather than dominate it.
sites.why_it_works: It covers present role, trajectory, interests, recognition, and contact in almost exactly one minute.
borrow_for_alexander: State present, previous, and earlier trajectory in one paragraph
Include one genuine outside-work interest
End with a line of levity
avoid: Too many dated rows
Recognition that duplicates the portfolio
Treating mentoring or AI as unproven buzzwords
sites.accessibility_performance: Straightforward structure is robust; table rows must reflow cleanly and maintain contrast on mobile.
sites.capture_notes: Current roles extend beyond the 2025 awarded submission.

sites.name: Luc Hohler Design
sites.tone_and_confidence: Approachable and service-focused; the coffee invitation adds warmth to a technically broad profile.
sites.typography_and_layout: Dark high-contrast sections, oversized role labels, gradients, and small 3D/graphic objects.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Process steps alternate text and visual moments, creating a simple chapter rhythm.
sites.pointer_touch: Interactive 3D accents respond to movement, while scroll remains the primary progression.
sites.media_or_simulation: Small 3D illustrations visualize stages of the working method.
sites.why_it_works: A broad design-and-development offer becomes understandable through four concrete process stages in under a minute.
borrow_for_alexander: Use a recurring object to mark chapters
Explain working method in active language
Add one warm, ordinary invitation
avoid: Broad capability claims without client proof
Decorative 3D objects unrelated to meaning
Process language that sounds like an agency template
sites.accessibility_performance: 3D accents need fallbacks; French copy and large headings should retain sensible line lengths at narrow widths.
sites.capture_notes: Site reported a four-times-wide backing surface; the archived PNG was downsampled without cropping.

sites.name: Tomoya Okada — Portfolio v7
sites.tone_and_confidence: Humble, disciplined, and future-facing; ambition appears as continuous practice rather than self-celebration.
sites.typography_and_layout: Black canvas, oversized spaced letters, orange highlights, compact labels, and an intentionally sparse composition.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Smooth transformed scroll reveals short passages and large type as spatial panels.
sites.pointer_touch: Pointer motion adds energy to the sparse page; essential information remains text-based.
sites.media_or_simulation: Abstract motion and typographic space carry the experience without portfolio imagery.
sites.why_it_works: It is short enough for one minute and includes both present capability and desired direction.
borrow_for_alexander: Include one sentence about what comes next
Use aspiration as a chapter, not a closing cliché
Let sparse typography make the short copy feel substantial
avoid: Award-count scorekeeping as a main identity
Too little client context
Spatial movement that hides reading order
sites.accessibility_performance: Transformed scrolling needs semantic order, reduced-motion support, and reliable focus handling.
sites.capture_notes: Stitched because the transformed page reports a viewport-height document.

sites.name: Dennis Snellenberg — Portfolio
sites.tone_and_confidence: Confident and commercially clear; a specific fascination with micro-animation adds personal conviction.
sites.typography_and_layout: Generous white field, oversized neutral sans-serif, a bright blue circular motif, portrait photography, and simple numbered services.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Minimal smooth-scroll sequence; large headline, portrait, service blocks, and contact arrive in clean stages.
sites.pointer_touch: The circular motif and transitions respond subtly; the page avoids interaction overload.
sites.media_or_simulation: A single bold circle and portrait give a human focal point without becoming a separate experience.
sites.why_it_works: The page explains value, offer, differentiator, and enthusiasm in about one minute.
borrow_for_alexander: Name one craft detail that genuinely excites you
Use three compact professional facets
Combine a human portrait with one abstract recurring form
avoid: Generic global-company language
Leading too heavily with services
A jury credential that becomes the story
sites.accessibility_performance: Clean visual hierarchy is strong; transformed scrolling must retain keyboard and reduced-motion behavior.
sites.capture_notes: Awwwards lists the 2019 .nl submission; the current live site is on .com and has materially evolved.

sites.name: Agustin Burgos — Portfolio
sites.tone_and_confidence: Earnest and expert-led, but repeated reassurance and exhaustive lists dilute the personal voice.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large playful heading, dark backgrounds, dense technical lists, timeline rows, and animated graphic elements.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Long vertical progression moves from prose into increasingly database-like evidence and then a large contact section.
sites.pointer_touch: Motion and hover effects add polish, but the interaction is not essential to comprehension.
sites.media_or_simulation: Animated graphic motifs create energy around a résumé-heavy page.
sites.why_it_works: It demonstrates depth and leaves little ambiguity about the technical offer; it is most useful as a counterexample for brevity.
borrow_for_alexander: Use one unexpected personal qualification or hobby for levity
Show a selective trajectory
Make capability concrete
avoid: Exhaustive tool inventories
Repeated claims of understanding client needs
More than two minutes of résumé copy
A contact form larger than the story
sites.accessibility_performance: Dense lists are difficult to scan on mobile; animated backgrounds should not reduce text contrast or delay interaction.
sites.capture_notes: Visible count includes navigation, skills, certifications, and contact labels.

sites.name: Grilled Pixels - Adam Roberts
sites.tone_and_confidence: Direct, energetic and craft-proud. Confidence comes from specificity and longevity, then softens through family images and an endearing early-web origin story.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized condensed display type, numbered editorial sections, a tight monochrome palette, and irregularly placed media create a magazine-like personal dossier.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Long vertical sequence with section counters, scale shifts and image reveals; the page alternates dense proof with lighter human moments.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover and cursor feedback support calls to action and media; the story remains readable without them.
sites.media_or_simulation: Portrait and candid family photography interrupt the professional narrative; motion and WebGL capability are described and demonstrated in page behavior.
sites.why_it_works: It proves range through a coherent life story rather than a detached skills list. Specific dates, collaborators and formative detail make the confidence believable.
borrow_for_alexander: one vivid origin detail
professional proof followed by a human image interruption
numbered chapters that make a long page skimmable
avoid: the full length is far beyond a one-minute read
large service inventories repeat the portfolio
too many award metrics can feel self-congratulatory
sites.accessibility_performance: Heavy animation and custom cursor treatment increase cognitive and GPU load. Provide reduced-motion behavior and avoid making body copy depend on reveal completion.
sites.capture_notes: Visible body text includes navigation and interface labels, so word count is an upper bound.

sites.name: Won J. You Studios - My Story
sites.creator_type: individual design leader, educator and coach
sites.tone_and_confidence: Warm, optimistic and deliberately characterful. Bold labels such as tech optimist and design geek give permission for personality, while the evidence stays concrete.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large kinetic type and repeated self-descriptors run through a minimalist grid; portraits and small factual paragraphs provide contrast.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A directive to scroll begins a paced transformation from manifesto to person to proof. Text bands, image sequences and press modules create clear tempo changes.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover and tap animate media and links, but scrolling carries the narrative.
sites.media_or_simulation: A portrait sequence behaves like an animated contact sheet; repeated image states make one person feel lively without adding decorative subject matter.
sites.why_it_works: The page turns a career pivot into a simple story: what I did, what it taught me, and what I am here to do next.
borrow_for_alexander: state the future-facing mission early
use a short personality ticker as levity
make client proof a chapter rather than a logo wall
show teaching or community impact as an outcome
avoid: press inventory becomes repetitive
self-labels need restraint to avoid feeling manufactured
the page still exceeds the desired one-minute read
sites.accessibility_performance: The page produced many browser warnings and is very tall. Repeated animated images need lazy loading, meaningful alternatives and reduced-motion fallbacks.
sites.capture_notes: Motion clip shows the opening narrative cadence; full capture includes all revealed sections.

sites.name: Righteous Creative
sites.award: 2026 · Webby Winner and People's Voice Winner · Professional Services & Self-Promotion
narrative_sequence: team portraits with humorous role labels
sites.tone_and_confidence: Dry, irreverent and anti-theatre. It sounds experienced without posturing because it names the industry behavior the founders reject.
sites.typography_and_layout: Huge stretched letterforms and a sparse black field create swagger; compact team cards and game-like class labels puncture the seriousness.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A short single-page scroll; large typographic transitions turn five small content beats into a complete arc.
sites.pointer_touch: Portrait alternatives and subtle hover reactions add play without becoming the route through the content.
sites.media_or_simulation: Animated portraits and role archetypes carry most of the personality; there is no unnecessary showreel interruption.
sites.why_it_works: This is the clearest one-minute benchmark: one promise, three people, one reason for existing, one memorable cultural texture.
borrow_for_alexander: use a specific enemy or tension to explain the practice
let one playful personal reference do the work of a hobbies list
target roughly 250 to 300 core words
avoid: nostalgia can narrow the audience if overused
anti-agency language would feel borrowed unless it reflects Alexander's actual experience
sites.accessibility_performance: Very large type must preserve readable line breaks on mobile. Decorative character animations should be hidden from assistive technology.
sites.capture_notes: The live page is effectively its own substantive About page.

sites.name: Fiddle.Digital
sites.tone_and_confidence: Poetic and earnest, with confidence located in a recurring harmony metaphor and the proof of an open-source tool.
sites.typography_and_layout: Editorial serif/sans contrast, Japanese annotations, dense but carefully measured text blocks, and audio-player UI create a distinct authored world.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Each paragraph arrives as a discrete composition. The rhythm alternates philosophy, interaction and credential blocks rather than stacking prose.
sites.pointer_touch: The embedded player, hover details and tactile contact treatment reward exploration; all main claims remain visible in the scroll.
sites.media_or_simulation: Music is both interface and organizing metaphor. StringTune, the studio's own animation library, serves as a credible side-project proof point.
sites.why_it_works: The metaphor is not decoration: harmony links positioning, motion, interaction, process and the side project into one idea.
borrow_for_alexander: choose one governing metaphor for text and motion
use one self-initiated tool or experiment as proof of curiosity
alternate belief statements with playable moments
avoid: abstract belief copy can become vague
award counts should not dominate
audio needs explicit user control
sites.accessibility_performance: Autoplay audio must remain off; player controls need keyboard labels. Scroll animation should respect reduced motion.
sites.capture_notes: Motion clip demonstrates paragraph and media pacing.

sites.name: Raw Materials - An Unusual Design Company
sites.award: 2024 · Two Webby Wins · Professional Services & Self-Promotion and Best Navigation/Structure
narrative_sequence: principle that difference creates better outcomes
sites.tone_and_confidence: Provocative but reasoned. The unusual claim is immediately explained as a practical competitive principle.
sites.typography_and_layout: An experimental app-like canvas, bold color fields and modular cards avoid the conventional agency-page stack.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Wheel input drives a virtual, spatial sequence rather than normal document flow; content behaves like connected scenes.
sites.pointer_touch: Drag, hover and directional navigation are structural, making this more interaction-led than Alexander's intended scroll-first balance.
sites.media_or_simulation: Work and identity live in the same spatial canvas. The interface itself is the demonstration.
sites.why_it_works: A single defensible word, unusual, organizes the proposition and interaction model.
borrow_for_alexander: name one principle and make every reveal reinforce it
treat images and experiments as connected scenes
let the interface demonstrate the stated specialty
avoid: do not copy the nonstandard navigation
a studio manifesto does not map directly to a personal biography
virtual scrolling complicates accessibility and capture
sites.accessibility_performance: The fixed virtual canvas obscures normal document height and can challenge keyboard, screen-reader and reduced-motion users. A semantic parallel flow is essential.
sites.capture_notes: The site uses a fixed virtual canvas; ten consecutive wheel-driven viewport states were stitched so content is visible. Browser text count included hidden application content and was not used.

sites.name: Lusion - About Us
sites.creator_type: six-person creative production studio; small-studio mismatch
sites.award: 2024 · Webby Winner and Nominee · Best Mobile Visual Design - Aesthetic; Professional Services & Self-Promotion
sites.tone_and_confidence: Precise, global and production-minded. Short declarative statements let the visual craft provide most of the confidence.
sites.typography_and_layout: Enormous all-caps statements, disciplined white space and small data-like labels produce a cinematic but legible contrast.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Virtual scrolling choreographs type, 3D and lists as large scenes. Expandable expertise restores user control after the cinematic opening.
sites.pointer_touch: Accordion-like capability controls and 3D reactions are secondary to wheel/touch scrolling.
sites.media_or_simulation: 3D forms are used as connective tissue, not separate portfolio pieces; motion demonstrates the studio's production specialty.
sites.why_it_works: The copy is short enough that sophisticated motion never competes with a dense biography.
borrow_for_alexander: use one spatial dot/point-cloud system as connective tissue
keep scene copy to one thought
pair expressive scenes with compact factual lists
avoid: studio capability grids are too broad for a personal page
award totals risk becoming the emotional climax
virtual scroll should not replace native scroll
sites.accessibility_performance: 3D and fixed-canvas behavior require a reduced-motion and low-power mode. Accordions need explicit states and keyboard support.
sites.capture_notes: Ten wheel-driven states were stitched because the smooth-scroll canvas reports one viewport of document height.

sites.name: Locomotive - Agency
sites.tone_and_confidence: Playful, technically literate and civic. Montréal identity and a Triforce metaphor make the operating model memorable.
sites.typography_and_layout: Big clean type is disrupted by emoji-like symbols, counters and label fragments; the page feels systematic without becoming corporate.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Native vertical chapters alternate manifesto, capability and team density. The embedded film is optional rather than a gate.
sites.pointer_touch: Team entries expand for biographies; the expandable layer is additive, which maps well to tap interaction.
sites.media_or_simulation: A short manifesto film provides a richer layer without replacing the written summary.
sites.why_it_works: The Triforce reduces operations, design and development into an understandable personal mythology.
borrow_for_alexander: compress overlapping specialties into a simple three-part model
let taps expand optional detail
use place as texture only if it explains the practice
avoid: large team and awards sections are not relevant to an individual
symbols must not create reading noise
sites.accessibility_performance: Symbol-heavy labels need clear accessible names. Optional video requires captions and pause controls.
sites.capture_notes: Team expansions were left closed to represent the default one-pass reading experience.

sites.name: Someoddpilot - About
sites.tone_and_confidence: Culturally fluent, candid and slightly rebellious. The language rejects marketing gloss while remaining generous toward collaborators.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large manifesto typography, black-and-white imagery and alternating grids produce a zine/editorial cadence.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: The page shifts rhythm every few screens: story, principles, facts, quotes, portraits, side projects. This prevents a long page from feeling like one essay.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover reveals and linked side ventures invite detours, but the main story reads linearly.
sites.media_or_simulation: Photography, record-label history, an art gallery and apparel work prove cultural interests without a conventional hobbies section.
sites.why_it_works: Side projects are presented as evidence of a worldview and business evolution, never as random decoration.
borrow_for_alexander: frame small projects as evidence of taste
alternate a belief with a concrete fact
end with one unexpected side-world
use client voice sparingly to validate tone
avoid: the full leadership roster is too long
many manifesto statements compete for attention
individual copy should use I rather than imported studio we language
sites.accessibility_performance: Long animated pages need landmarks and skip links. Image-heavy blocks should use responsive assets and meaningful alt text.
sites.capture_notes: Default biography and side-venture states are visible; linked sub-sites were not followed.

sites.name: Better Off Studio - The Lookback
narrative_sequence: why looking back clarifies the future
monthly index of work, music, inspiration and clients
sites.tone_and_confidence: Self-aware, culturally alert and lightly boastful with a wink. It admits that the archive is a flex, then explains why reflection is useful.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized date and archive typography, black fields and index labels turn an annual recap into an editorial object.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A fixed virtual-scroller moves from declaration into a month-by-month archive. The index structure gives side material an organizing reason.
sites.pointer_touch: Music and archive items are browsable, while the About statement remains the linear entry point.
sites.media_or_simulation: Playlists, inspiration, client moments and case studies share one time-based system; taste becomes part of professional identity.
sites.why_it_works: It offers the best answer to how side projects can be sprinkled in: bind them to time, influence or a recurring theme.
borrow_for_alexander: package posters and experiments as a small cabinet of current obsessions
make levity a final recurring archive beat
connect looking back to future aspiration
avoid: a calendar archive would overwhelm a one-minute About page
do not expose unfinished filler months
music autoplay would be intrusive
sites.accessibility_performance: Fixed virtual scrolling and background audio need strong fallbacks. Every archive item should be reachable by keyboard and represented in semantic order.
sites.capture_notes: Ten wheel-driven states were stitched because the app uses a fixed virtual canvas. This page is an About/annual taste archive attached to the nominated studio site.

sites.name: Metalab - About
sites.creator_type: global product design firm; large-team mismatch
sites.tone_and_confidence: Friendly, factual and employee-led. The firm lets named people and measurable practices carry the claims.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large conversational headings, horizontal place names, portrait grids and compact metrics create a human data-story.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A restrained vertical sequence moves from global scale to individual voices to quantified culture.
sites.pointer_touch: Drag and hover are explicitly signposted on image and location modules, adding play without hiding the text.
sites.media_or_simulation: Remote-work portraits and desk photographs make an abstract distributed team tangible.
sites.why_it_works: Claims such as autonomy and balance are immediately followed by employee testimony and policies.
borrow_for_alexander: follow each belief with evidence
use a few client or collaborator voices instead of self-praise
turn trajectory into named places or environments only when meaningful
avoid: employment metrics are irrelevant to a personal site
generic culture claims without proof
drag cues should not distract from scroll
sites.accessibility_performance: Draggable visuals need non-drag alternatives. Diversity metrics require context rather than purely visual presentation.
sites.capture_notes: Current live page is recruitment-oriented; principles were extracted for individual-profile use and the scale mismatch is explicit.

sites.name: Dops Agency
sites.award: 2024 · People's Voice Winner · Professional Services & Self-Promotion
sites.tone_and_confidence: Polished, enthusiastic and client-centered. Repeated references to user desire keep the language outward-facing rather than autobiographical.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large staggered statements, glowing imagery and modular work cards create a high-energy studio showcase.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A long home/About hybrid alternates proof and explanation; testimonial typography provides useful tempo changes.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover states animate project previews and service labels; scroll retains control.
sites.media_or_simulation: 3D motion and animated case media demonstrate capability, though they are more portfolio than biography.
sites.why_it_works: The page does not merely say passionate or visionary; it places those values beside work, testimonials and client numbers.
borrow_for_alexander: keep confidence outward-facing by describing client or user benefit
use one short testimonial as a change of voice
pair each specialty with a visual proof fragment
avoid: adjectives such as visionary become generic when repeated
logo and award walls are too corporate
do not duplicate the Portfolio route
sites.accessibility_performance: Animated media and luminous contrast need reduced-motion testing and accessible text contrast. Dense project grids require clear focus states.
sites.capture_notes: The substantive About content is integrated into the one-page studio home.

sites.name: AW Portfolio - Antoine Wodniack
sites.tone_and_confidence: Extremely concise and matter-of-fact. A single chronological sentence covers tools, roles, projects, leadership and ongoing learning.
sites.typography_and_layout: A saturated red field, giant condensed type, binary texture and geometric WebGL/canvas forms turn minimal copy into a strong authored environment.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: The native scroll moves through pinned typographic and geometric scenes. Text is sparse enough to be read while the spatial composition changes.
sites.pointer_touch: Contrast control and geometric reactions add agency; the biography itself requires no interaction.
sites.media_or_simulation: Abstract grids and forms visualize coding and motion without showing generic code screenshots.
sites.why_it_works: This is the best word-count benchmark. The career sentence is dense with evidence, while the page behavior supplies excitement.
borrow_for_alexander: compress trajectory into one vivid sentence
let the visual system carry emotion so copy can stay short
state availability or aspiration plainly
use abstract dot geometry instead of illustrative filler
avoid: an awards-only proof section can feel narrow
extreme color and condensed type reduce long-form readability
pinned scenes must not create blank scroll regions
sites.accessibility_performance: High saturation and condensed display type need contrast and readability checks. Canvas decoration should be ignored by assistive technology and disabled for reduced motion.
sites.capture_notes: Twelve viewport states were stitched because one full-page capture left blank areas around pinned scenes. Word count excludes decorative binary digits.

sites.name: Mark Woodland
narrative_sequence: three initiatives linked to human outcomes
sites.tone_and_confidence: Purposeful, civic and controlled. Confidence comes from connecting every venture to a human outcome, not from describing the founder as exceptional.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized editorial typography, periwinkle/blue color fields, rounded media and numbered policy chapters create a contemporary public-leadership profile.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Vertical scroll is the backbone; pinned topic transitions and optional video deepen the story. Repeated keep-scrolling cues sustain momentum.
sites.pointer_touch: Users can choose housing, education or healthcare and play short takes. These interactions expand a clear default narrative.
sites.media_or_simulation: Founder video is divided by topic, avoiding a single long showreel. Venture cards connect abstract beliefs to real systems.
sites.why_it_works: The page converts a complicated multi-industry career into one belief, three proof points and three optional deeper topics.
borrow_for_alexander: use one belief as the spine
group clients and projects by the change Alexander helps create
offer optional tap-to-expand stories
end on an outward-looking aspiration
avoid: repeated issue copy pushes beyond one minute
video errors or missing captions damage credibility
public-leadership gravitas should not displace playfulness
sites.accessibility_performance: Observed browser console errors around media did not prevent the text capture but are a risk. Videos require captions, poster fallbacks and reduced-motion-safe transitions.
sites.capture_notes: Full page captured; optional topic videos were not opened so the default reading path remains visible.

sites.name: Camila Rosa
sites.tone_and_confidence: Warm and direct. Confidence comes from specificity and the work's social point of view, then from quiet evidence rather than adjectives.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large declarative headline over a restrained two-column editorial grid; dense credentials are reduced to labeled counts that open on demand.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A short vertical scroll. The face/eye illustration gives the opening personality; achievement rows disclose detail on interaction without burdening the first read.
sites.pointer_touch: Click/tap rows reveal lists. Navigation remains conventional and touch-safe.
sites.media_or_simulation: Expressive portrait illustration and eye motif; no gratuitous simulation.
sites.why_it_works: It separates identity from proof: two sentences explain the practice, while clients and achievements supply credibility in compressed form.
borrow_for_alexander: Use one memorable personal visual, two sharply edited statements, then evidence as expandable counts. This is a strong model for a one-minute Alexander page.
avoid: A long undifferentiated client list can become wallpaper; cluster or animate only enough to preserve recognition.
sites.accessibility_performance: The icon-like expandable rows need explicit button semantics, focus states, and expanded-state announcements. Motion should not be required to understand the content.
sites.capture_notes: All page sections were scrolled through before capture so lazy content was loaded. Full page captured at 1440px CSS width.

sites.name: Elsa Hanneke
sites.creator_type: individual artist and interdisciplinary creative director
sites.tone_and_confidence: Cool, concise, and assured. It never claims greatness; the client list and recognition ledger do the status work.
sites.typography_and_layout: Monospaced/editorial system with small section labels and spacious columns. The entire About page fits in one desktop viewport.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: No scrolling is necessary on desktop; the work index carries the spatial innovation while About becomes a calm information panel.
sites.pointer_touch: Black/white background switch and standard links. Low interaction burden.
sites.media_or_simulation: About is text-only, contrasting with the spatial project index and moving media elsewhere in the portfolio.
sites.why_it_works: The page knows its job: orientation and proof. It avoids repeating portfolio content and creates a deliberate pause in an otherwise immersive site.
borrow_for_alexander: A visually ambitious portfolio does not require every About moment to perform. Let expressive typography and spatial transitions frame concise facts.
avoid: The client block is impressive but emotionally cool; Alexander needs at least one human detail or belief to avoid reading like a credits list.
sites.accessibility_performance: The background controls must retain contrast and accessible names. Tiny monospaced type needs careful mobile sizing.
sites.capture_notes: Complete one-viewport About page captured at 1440x1000; no hidden lower sections.

sites.name: Wendy Andrade
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Poetic and third-person. Confidence comes from a clear cultural purpose and a single Wired recognition, not a catalogue of achievements.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large portrait and generous whitespace; one substantial paragraph is treated as an art statement rather than résumé copy.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Simple vertical movement with the portrait preceding the statement. The image-to-text ratio creates a slow, reflective reveal.
sites.pointer_touch: Minimal; language switch and contact links only.
sites.media_or_simulation: One portrait. The broader site uses a fluid stream of titles and media inspired by water.
sites.why_it_works: It gives the practice a worldview in roughly one paragraph. The page feels authored even with very little interface.
borrow_for_alexander: A compact About can be memorable when it names what the work is for, not only what the person does.
avoid: Dense third-person prose can feel like gallery copy and may distance the reader. Break Alexander's copy into more breathable beats.
sites.accessibility_performance: Ensure language controls expose state and that the portrait has useful alt text. Long line lengths should be constrained.
sites.capture_notes: English Bio URL redirected correctly; complete 2031px page captured after lazy-load scroll.

sites.name: Ania Melnik
sites.creator_type: individual multidisciplinary designer and AI artist
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Energetic, maximal, commercial, and highly self-assured. The breadth is impressive but the repeated superlatives push toward sales copy.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized kinetic sentences, repeated vertical modules, marquee fragments, and an intentionally dense multi-section scroll.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Long vertical page with word-by-word text entrances, embedded motion, repeated capability modules, and section color/rhythm changes.
sites.pointer_touch: Anchor navigation, social links, and repeated collaboration calls. Much of the experience is scroll-triggered rather than pointer-led.
sites.media_or_simulation: Embedded moving media, oversized type, and animated section choreography rather than a single signature simulation.
sites.why_it_works: It proves that type alone can carry sustained kinetic rhythm, but it is intentionally not efficient as a one-minute profile.
borrow_for_alexander: Borrow the alternating typographic scale and clear chapter changes, not the volume. One strong sentence per beat is enough.
avoid: Role stacking, repeated calls to action, duplicated claims, long service inventories, and percentage-style expertise all make the profile feel less selective.
sites.accessibility_performance: Letter-split DOM creates an extremely noisy accessibility tree; motion density, embedded media, and long scroll increase cognitive and performance cost. Reduced-motion behavior is essential.
sites.capture_notes: Full 8762px one-page profile captured after all sections were scrolled into view. This is intentionally retained as an anti-pattern/control case.

sites.name: Alex Ryan Design
sites.creator_type: independent identity, web, and digital designer
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Confident and commercially clear, with a conversational close. Evidence is concrete, though the category-redefining promise is more assertive than the supporting story.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large split typography opens the page; compact editorial lists and modular cards create a measured downward rhythm.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Vertical scroll with word-level entrances and distinct sections. Dark-mode control adds a light secondary interaction.
sites.pointer_touch: Theme toggle, links, and copy-email affordance. Interaction supports rather than competes with reading.
sites.media_or_simulation: The About page is primarily kinetic typography; project media remains outside the narrative.
sites.why_it_works: The two engagement models answer a practical hiring question most About pages ignore, turning biography into useful decision support.
borrow_for_alexander: Include a compact 'how I work with teams' beat; it makes professional positioning more actionable than a generic skills list.
avoid: Awards descriptions and the long client wall duplicate proof. Trim to the strongest handful for a one-minute page.
sites.accessibility_performance: Word-split animation should preserve a clean accessible name. The dark-mode toggle needs persistent state and sufficient contrast.
sites.capture_notes: Full 3041px About page captured after triggering all scroll entrances. This site replaced Tomoya Okada to avoid cross-lane duplication.

sites.name: Luca Ravanelli
sites.creator_type: small art-direction and motion-design studio led by an individual
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Formal, exacting, and philosophy-led. Confidence is expressed through principles such as reduction, grids, precision, and synthesis.
sites.typography_and_layout: Minimal black-and-white Swiss/editorial grid; a large About title gives way to compact, information-dense columns.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Short conventional vertical scroll with subtle type entrances. Information density increases below the opening statement.
sites.pointer_touch: Straightforward links and downloadable CV; no interaction gimmick.
sites.media_or_simulation: No media on About. The site's playground holds motion studies, maintaining a useful separation between biography and experimentation.
sites.why_it_works: A single coherent principle explains both style and studio evolution. The page then acts as a reference sheet for serious enquiries.
borrow_for_alexander: Lead with a belief that actually governs decisions, then use a compact ledger for proof. Alexander can do this more warmly and with fewer lists.
avoid: The philosophy paragraph is abstract and the lower half becomes administrative. Add a concrete example or playful interruption before attention drops.
sites.accessibility_performance: Very small secondary type and long lists may be tiring on mobile; ensure headings and list semantics remain intact through animation.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 1991px About page captured; all lists and footer content visible.

sites.name: Maria Vareva
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Calm, intelligent, and self-aware. Numbering contains the confidence; the prose stays factual and avoids inflated claims.
sites.typography_and_layout: One very large paragraph becomes the entire page. Numbered clauses, line breaks, and linked nouns create rhythm without extra interface chrome.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A focused 2903px vertical reading experience. The text enters progressively and linked trajectory items act as visual anchors.
sites.pointer_touch: Links deepen specific career claims; otherwise scrolling remains primary.
sites.media_or_simulation: Minimal animated marks associated with linked projects; the core story is typographic.
sites.why_it_works: It integrates role, past, beliefs, and values into 151 words. The sequence answers who, where from, how, and why in under a minute.
borrow_for_alexander: This is the strongest content architecture for Alexander: current edge, selective trajectory, actual principles, and human values, each in one numbered beat.
avoid: A single giant paragraph may be hard to scan and feels formal. Alexander should add one or two playful media interruptions and stronger mobile chunking.
sites.accessibility_performance: Word-level animation and large text must preserve natural reading order. Embedded linked objects should not interrupt keyboard flow.
sites.capture_notes: Full About page captured after scroll reveals; all 151 words and footer visible.

sites.name: Aya El Ouahdani
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Playful, energetic, and game-like. Confidence is expressed through a complete fictional system rather than conventional biography.
sites.typography_and_layout: Terminal language, outlined panels, neon accents, counters, and modular cards create a coherent interface fiction.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Long vertical scroll; trait meters animate, projects react on hover, and a secondary Aurora mode alters the atmosphere.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover-to-preview modules, mode switch, project controls, and contact buttons. On touch, hover semantics require an alternate first-tap behavior.
sites.media_or_simulation: Animated avatar, progress meters, interactive project previews, and game/terminal motifs.
sites.why_it_works: Every interaction reinforces the maker's developer identity. The fiction is consistent rather than decorative.
borrow_for_alexander: Choose one behavioral metaphor tied to Alexander's actual practice—such as spatial scan/dot field—and let it govern reveals, labels, and transitions.
avoid: Tool percentages, broad capability lists, and system jargon overwhelm the human story. Do not let the metaphor consume the one-minute narrative.
sites.accessibility_performance: Hover instructions are not touch-complete; small terminal text, heavy animation, and generic progress values create usability and performance risks. A reduced-motion and non-WebGL path is necessary.
sites.capture_notes: Full 9400px one-page portfolio captured after all modules and lazy media were scrolled through.

sites.name: Stan Khoruzhenko
sites.creator_type: individual design leader and product designer
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Direct and highly outcome-oriented. The confidence is credible when tied to numbers, but the uninterrupted first-person pitch is intense.
sites.typography_and_layout: Single dense narrative column with inline company links; minimal visual hierarchy beyond the Introduction label.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Short 1805px scroll and no material reveals. The page reads like a high-impact cover letter.
sites.pointer_touch: Inline links to employers and case studies; otherwise static.
sites.media_or_simulation: None on the Bio page, despite a more animated work homepage.
sites.why_it_works: It explains contribution, scope, and measurable outcome instead of listing generic responsibilities.
borrow_for_alexander: Alexander's trajectory should name what changed because of his work, not only where he worked. One or two verified outcomes can carry considerable authority.
avoid: The wall of text exceeds a comfortable one-minute scan and repeats 'I'. Break the arc into chapters and reserve numbers for the most meaningful evidence.
sites.accessibility_performance: Readable semantics and low runtime cost, but line length and paragraph density reduce comprehension, especially on smaller screens.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 1805px Bio captured after all content loaded.

sites.name: AKIS.STUDIO
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Warm and earnest but agency-generic in places. Confidence comes from a visible team and a partnership promise more than from awards.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large kinetic headings alternate with images, short paragraphs, team cards, and logo fields across a long editorial scroll.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Scroll is the main narrative engine; oversized headings reveal word by word, team cards move horizontally, and image scale resets pacing.
sites.pointer_touch: Carousel controls and standard links; no essential hover-only information.
sites.media_or_simulation: Team photography and an animated hero scene; the media is tied to place and people.
sites.why_it_works: The alternating rhythm is strong even when the writing is long. Team portraits turn abstract collaboration claims into visible evidence.
borrow_for_alexander: Use recurring large-type chapters separated by one concrete image, artifact, or simulation. Alexander can create the same rhythm with side projects and dot-field moments.
avoid: Repeated passion/authenticity/excellence language and a 494-word page feel generic. Specific decisions and outcomes are more persuasive.
sites.accessibility_performance: Very tall page and animated split text increase runtime cost; carousel must remain keyboard/touch accessible and reduced-motion should flatten heading reveals.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 11967px Studio page captured after all scroll reveals and team/client media loaded.

sites.name: Jess Hill
sites.creator_type: individual author, journalist, educator, and advocate
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
narrative_sequence: book and newsletter calls to action
sites.tone_and_confidence: Authoritative, candid, and deeply personal. It earns confidence through reporting detail and vulnerability rather than self-promotion.
sites.typography_and_layout: Editorial longform with sticky chapter navigation, large images, timelines, award cards, and intimate captions.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A 15370px chaptered vertical story. Sticky anchors make the long page navigable; image/caption interludes continually reset the reading rhythm.
sites.pointer_touch: Anchor navigation, expandable award media, and article/book links. Scrolling remains dominant.
sites.media_or_simulation: Portraits, archival photographs, awards, videos, personal snapshots, and captions; no abstract simulation.
sites.why_it_works: It is not reading-efficient, but it demonstrates how professional trajectory becomes a story through turning points, mentors, stakes, and human detail.
borrow_for_alexander: Borrow the chapter anchors and the alternation between professional turning points and small human artifacts. Compress the same technique into five Alexander beats.
avoid: Eleven-plus minutes is far outside the brief. Exhaustive awards and biography should live in expandable/archive layers, not the primary one-minute path.
sites.accessibility_performance: Strong semantic headings and anchor navigation, but page weight, many images/videos, and extremely long reading time create cognitive and performance costs. Media lightboxes need focus management.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 15370px page captured after every chapter was scrolled. Retained as the strongest narrative reference and clearest length anti-pattern.

sites.name: Bogdan Kolomiyets
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Confident, conversational, and funny. It repeatedly frames expertise as client benefit and uses self-deprecation to prevent the pitch from feeling pompous.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized statements, annotated personal image collage, numerical proof blocks, and numbered manifesto cards.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Strong vertical pacing across 7565px: image collage, metric reveals, a large personal-service sentence, then four belief modules.
sites.pointer_touch: Mostly scrolling and links. Images and text animate into place; no interaction is required for core content.
sites.media_or_simulation: Personal photographs of wife, dog, seaside life, and humorous snapshots. These are meaning-bearing rather than decorative.
sites.why_it_works: It solves the confidence/likeability balance unusually well. Beliefs are stated as client-relevant truths, then levity closes the loop.
borrow_for_alexander: Use one unexpected personal artifact, one plain-English service promise, and a short belief set. End with a joke that still advances the contact decision.
avoid: The conversion language can feel overly sales-driven, and 320 words still exceeds the one-minute target. Keep only the best two beliefs.
sites.accessibility_performance: Split text creates a large DOM and animated statistics must expose stable text. Personal images need meaningful alt descriptions; reveal motion should respect reduced-motion.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 7565px About page captured after all counters, photos, and manifesto modules loaded.

sites.name: Giacomo Agnello Modica
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Cheerful, specific, and disarming. Major clients and recognition are balanced by drag theatre, an old bicycle, comfort food, divas, and rainy places.
sites.typography_and_layout: Illustrated fragments, short paragraphs, client names, and playful button-like phrases create an informal scrapbook rhythm.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A concise 3316px scroll. Hover/tap ingredient buttons reveal corresponding visual references, making the taste statement interactive.
sites.pointer_touch: Influence and favorite-thing buttons are optional playful layers; core biography stays visible without interaction.
sites.media_or_simulation: Illustrated self-portrait fragments, influence images, personal references, and self-produced merchandise.
sites.why_it_works: Every playful detail explains the work's visual language. Personality, side work, and professional proof are not separate decorations—they form one causal story.
borrow_for_alexander: This is the strongest model for Alexander's side-project sprinkling: let artifacts reveal influences and taste, and make each interaction answer 'why is this here?'.
avoid: The client list could be shorter, and copy errors weaken polish. Ensure interaction labels work on both hover and tap.
sites.accessibility_performance: Some figures lacked accessible image names in the captured accessibility tree. Button-revealed images need alt text, keyboard triggers, and persistent touch behavior.
sites.capture_notes: Cookie notice declined before capture. Complete 3316px Info page captured after all lazy content loaded.
